# SafeProxyFactory

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/04c494d92ce87df3b9ba252c17541e08e28fdf97/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/proxies/SafeProxyFactory.sol)

**Title:** Proxy Factory - Allows to create a new proxy contract and execute a message call to the new proxy within one transaction.

**Author:** Stefan George - @Georgi87

## Functions

<a id="proxycreationcode"></a>

### proxyCreationCode

<i>

Allows to retrieve the creation code used for the Proxy deployment. With this it is easily possible to calculate predicted address.

</i>

```solidity
function proxyCreationCode() public pure returns (bytes memory);
```

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bytes` |  |

<a id="deployproxy-address-bytes-bytes32"></a>

### deployProxy

Internal method to create a new proxy contract using CREATE2. Optionally executes an initializer call to a new proxy.

```solidity
function deployProxy(address _singleton, bytes memory initializer, bytes32 salt) internal returns (SafeProxy proxy);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _singleton | `address` | Address of singleton contract. Must be deployed at the time of execution. |
| initializer | `bytes` | (Optional) Payload for a message call to be sent to a new proxy contract. |
| salt | `bytes32` | Create2 salt to use for calculating the address of the new proxy contract. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| proxy | `SafeProxy` | Address of the new proxy contract. |

<a id="createproxywithnonce-address-bytes-uint256"></a>

### createProxyWithNonce

Deploys a new proxy with `_singleton` singleton and `saltNonce` salt. Optionally executes an initializer call to a new proxy.

```solidity
function createProxyWithNonce(address _singleton, bytes memory initializer, uint256 saltNonce) public returns (SafeProxy proxy);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _singleton | `address` | Address of singleton contract. Must be deployed at the time of execution. |
| initializer | `bytes` | Payload for a message call to be sent to a new proxy contract. |
| saltNonce | `uint256` | Nonce that will be used to generate the salt to calculate the address of the new proxy contract. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| proxy | `SafeProxy` |  |

<a id="createchainspecificproxywithnonce-address-bytes-uint256"></a>

### createChainSpecificProxyWithNonce

Deploys a new chain-specific proxy with `_singleton` singleton and `saltNonce` salt. Optionally executes an initializer call to a new proxy.

<i>

Allows to create a new proxy contract that should exist only on 1 network (e.g. specific governance or admin accounts)
     by including the chain id in the create2 salt. Such proxies cannot be created on other networks by replaying the transaction.

</i>

```solidity
function createChainSpecificProxyWithNonce(
        address _singleton,
        bytes memory initializer,
        uint256 saltNonce
    ) public returns (SafeProxy proxy);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _singleton | `address` | Address of singleton contract. Must be deployed at the time of execution. |
| initializer | `bytes` | Payload for a message call to be sent to a new proxy contract. |
| saltNonce | `uint256` | Nonce that will be used to generate the salt to calculate the address of the new proxy contract. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| proxy | `SafeProxy` |  |

<a id="createproxywithcallback-address-bytes-uint256-iproxycreationcallback"></a>

### createProxyWithCallback

Deploy a new proxy with `_singleton` singleton and `saltNonce` salt.
        Optionally executes an initializer call to a new proxy and calls a specified callback address `callback`.

```solidity
function createProxyWithCallback(
        address _singleton,
        bytes memory initializer,
        uint256 saltNonce,
        IProxyCreationCallback callback
    ) public returns (SafeProxy proxy);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _singleton | `address` | Address of singleton contract. Must be deployed at the time of execution. |
| initializer | `bytes` | Payload for a message call to be sent to a new proxy contract. |
| saltNonce | `uint256` | Nonce that will be used to generate the salt to calculate the address of the new proxy contract. |
| callback | `IProxyCreationCallback` | Callback that will be invoked after the new proxy contract has been successfully deployed and initialized. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| proxy | `SafeProxy` |  |

<a id="iscontract-address"></a>

### isContract

Returns true if `account` is a contract.

<i>

This function will return false if invoked during the constructor of a contract,
     as the code is not actually created until after the constructor finishes.

</i>

```solidity
function isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| account | `address` | The address being queried |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bool` | True if `account` is a contract |

<a id="getchainid"></a>

### getChainId

Returns the ID of the chain the contract is currently deployed on.

```solidity
function getChainId() public view returns (uint256);
```

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `uint256` | The ID of the current chain as a uint256. |
